<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every partial law and admission, a property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it. The mediated machine's histories are the courses of its admitted steps, lawful reads and committed programs. A bounded overwrite program derives its executed change scope and transports actual and candidate states through the same semantics, so each admitted step keeps actual coverage; hence arbitrary finite histories of lawful reads and committed programs preserve actual coverage and feed current certification.
